steps.name: The Delivery Adventurer (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」. Obtain <Scylla's Doll Hat>, <Picus's Spool of Thread>, and <Glaucos's Horn> from 「Chaotic Mirror」 and 「Theater Eugamon」, then bring them to [Arche].

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Since you've come, %s, the spirit sent from Pneuma must have found you safely.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Were you all right on the way this time too? As I mentioned before, no pain as though your body were breaking apart, or fever as though you might vanish...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What a relief. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I heard you visited Aie Island after coming to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So word spread because I met Hayden.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: By rescuing Hayden, you allowed the spirits here to reach Aie Island too.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing. Oh, right. Arche, why did you call me?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I would love to go to Aie Island and help Hayden myself... But I cannot leave this place, so I'd like to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The witch's curse drove away or destroyed the spirits on Aie Island. The magic flowing through the island may have become somewhat contaminated.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Pneuma's spirits plan to go and purify it, but something must be done first.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: We need to understand the nature of the curse that shook Aie Island. If the precious spirits go unprepared, they might vanish before they can do any work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how can I help?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Could you bring objects belonging to the island's masters? With those, I think the spirits will be able to work hard and do their best.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you already have their belongings, you can give them to me now. Otherwise, please obtain them and bring them here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Arche. I'll bring them right away.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. You know these feelings aren't a secret, right? Hehe.

steps.name: The Delivery Adventurer (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then look for someone in 「Nereis Gateway」 who causes the Lepton to react.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There are more than you expected, aren't there? Thank you for gathering them.
(As Arche receives the objects from %s, spirits in the distance recognize them and approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do the spirits recognize the things I brought?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes. Once the spirits who carry emotions sense the feelings within these objects, that will be enough.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Their owners must be strong people. Even under a curse, they held on to the will and heart to remain themselves until the end...
(At Arche's words, the objects brought from Aie Island rise into the air. Slowly, they turn into something like sand in an hourglass and scatter somewhere in Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Now the spirits will go to Aie Island and begin the purification with Hayden.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: They cannot restore the bodies of those turned into dolls, but the island itself should return at least a little closer to how it was long ago.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Long ago...
(As Arche continues, a surprised expression crosses her face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's nothing. An image of Aie Island as it used to be suddenly came to mind. I don't know why...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Could I ask one more favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead, Arche.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: There is an Elec Lepton that needs to go to the Nereis Gateway rather than Aie Island. Could you take it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's no trouble. Do I simply bring it along? Ow, that stings. I mean this Lepton. Why does it need to go to the gateway?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It seems someone there needs a spirit's help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ow! All right. So I should go to the person the Lepton reacts to? Ow!

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If it still stings, would you like a blanket? It's made from fur shed by Kairos. It should be fine if you carry it wrapped up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you're right. Then I'll go straight to the Nereis Gateway.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you. The spirits seem very fond of you, %s. Even when a spirit is born...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean, when a spirit is born?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh... It's a secret.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A real secret.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You may learn someday, or I may tell you, but for now it's a secret. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. It isn't important right now.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you for helping me keep the secret. Travel safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Take care, Arche.
(When you reach the Nereis Gateway, the Lepton in %s's arms blinks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh? Lepton, what's wrong?
(The Lepton flies up and stares toward Edam.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was Edam the person the Lepton wanted to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it disappeared... It must be Edam, then. Should I ask him what's wrong?

steps.name: The Delivery Adventurer (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Edam] in 「Nereis Gateway」, then find [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.text: (During a quiet moment after the gateway's travelers have left, Edam stares blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam? What are you thinking about?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Pardon? Oh, %s. You're here?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Just thinking... No. Ever since that incident, this happens sometimes. I occasionally feel blank and anxious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: It doesn't affect my everyday life, but when it comes to escort or guard duties...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I need to overcome it somehow and be useful to Notos, Bjor, and you, %s... I'm ashamed to be in this state.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I can already imagine how pathetic my younger sibling would find me. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to burden you with this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Thank you for your concern when you're so busy. I've just finished preparing your room, %s.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Whenever you visit the Nereis Gateway, feel free to come up to the second floor of the building where Notos and I work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which room?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: The [Room of the Great %s].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Have you considered changing the room's name?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: His Majesty bestowed that name, so changing it won't be easy. But there is a way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so there is a way. What is it?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: You could seek an audience with His Majesty and tell him you wish to change it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll just make myself comfortable. It looks wonderfully comfortable. Anyway, thank you for your care, Edam.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: You're welcome. I only did my duty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha... Come to think of it, Edam, you were in Knossos, weren't you?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes. Knossos was my final posting as a ranger. It was so quiet it was almost desolate.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Since coming here and seeing so many people, the symptoms seem a little more frequent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You didn't feel as blank in Knossos?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: A beastfolk called Talos gave me a massage, and it seemed to help. He said his hands were healing potions and demanded that I pick up litter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, the one who likes picking up litter? That Talos?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had a little business in Knossos. He's quite an interesting person... Why do you look so surprised?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: People usually call them beastfolk. I've never heard someone specifically call one a person, so I was surprised. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to apologize. What do people call them, then?

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Just 'beastfolk.' I've thought of them that way since childhood too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos merely has animal ears, like the Kali tribe, yet they don't treat him as a person...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now that I'm thinking of it, should I visit Knossos...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edam, I think I need to go to Knossos. I remembered something I'd forgotten...

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: I've kept you too long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all, Edam. See you later.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: (Somehow, since %s arrived, that blank feeling seems to have eased... Why...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's rather shocking... If people in Freios treat those with animal ears like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ow, that stings... Lepton?
(The Elec Lepton that circled Edam and disappeared reappears before %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you've finished, go back to Pneuma. I have somewhere to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What are you writing in the air? Go. To. Knos. Sos. To. Get. Her?
(With that, the Lepton approaches and presses close to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...All right, all right. Let's go. But you seem heavier than before.
(As though understanding, the Lepton turns its gaze toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-Wait... I was only joking about you being heavy! Don't worry about it! How heavy could a spirit even... Aaaaagh, that stings!!

steps.name: The Delivery Adventurer (4)
steps.objective: First talk to [Talos] in 「Knossos」. Then defeat [Glaucos] in 「Theater Eugamon」 to obtain <Glaucos's Weapon>, return to 「Knossos」, and talk to [Talos] again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Back to pry something out of me again? Picking up litter won't be enough this...
(Talos recognizes the Lepton circling %s and looks surprised.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A fresh spirit, straight from Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You recognized it? Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A spirit isn't a fish for sale at a market stall.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I only stated the facts. Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Not exactly...
(The Lepton rises above Talos and begins looking around Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Why did you bring that spirit here? Spirits go about their own business... But seeing that it followed you...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Judging by that squashed-Priring face, you really don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It originally had another destination. After that, it just followed me. That's all I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what exactly is a Priring face?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Never mind. Perhaps the will of some great being, unknown to both of us, has manifested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepton, what do you want to do?
(The Lepton looks up at Knossos's sky, points somewhere with what seem to be its wings, then flies swiftly deeper into Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It went to the Beast King. I suppose someone who's confined needs help from others.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, it won't simply go back. While it's here, it'll help the living things in Knossos. Whatever else may be true, I'm grateful to spirits.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Now, if you're done, go home. I'm going to sleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Not for free.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I pulled some weeds and gathered litter on the way up to Knossos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That isn't enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe something like the magic brooms at the Magic Academy would do...
(At the words 'magic broom,' Talos's pupils widen.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What? A magic broom? Don't tell me the broom moves by itself and cleans automatically?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I had some trouble with them before...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What? They're using something that wonderful? Damn, I'm jealous...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Talos really takes cleaning seriously.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask at Xerenis Magic Academy sometime whether I can get one.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I appreciate it, but that still isn't enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I've shown this much goodwill. Aren't you being unreasonable?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It can't be helped. The broom isn't in my hands right now. By the way, it seems you've met someone connected to a god.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Didn't even have the courage to act directly, so they made an incarnation...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I haven't said a word about an incarnation. How does Talos know?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Stop thinking pointless thoughts. Go to that incarnation and ask for something Daedalus would like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daedalus...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Heh. I know what you're thinking. Don't do anything foolish. Just say he's alive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you doing? Aren't you going? Do you want me to tell you to travel safely?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No need. But if I don't come back, you'll never even see a magic broom.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll just clean with those idiot rangers over there. Are you really refusing to do something for the god you believe in?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine, I'm going. I'm going.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You've got a long way to go before you can beat me with words... What? Gone? Why leave? I wasn't finished.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Did I win because I annoyed you more...?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Welcome.
(As soon as you enter the theater, Glaucos greets %s by raising a hand and one of his many legs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Glaucos. That's quite a greeting.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was so pleased to see you that my greeting seems to have startled you. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I'm fine. What were you doing?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Repairing the theater. After all that commotion, quite a few places were damaged.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help too. I'm partly responsible for the damage.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: No need. Hayden, Scylla, and the spirits are helping, so it's all right.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I cannot ask the benefactor who saved this island and everyone on it to do hard labor.
(Smiling, Glaucos raises a foot holding a hammer.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Oh dear... I must have grown used to this form without realizing. I was repairing the stage so naturally...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: As I work, I keep wishing people would come here and watch my plays.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure they will.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thank you. Once the stage is properly ready, I'll invite you by my authority as director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. The thought alone means a lot.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: By the way, since you've come here, I imagine you have business with me...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Please speak freely. Will you give me a chance to repay the benefactor who gave me another chance at life?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll explain...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Glaucos what Talos said.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Daedalus...?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I haven't heard that name in a very long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Of course. He was a kind, goodhearted person who followed a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So he didn't always have his current personality...? Why did he change?)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Something Daedalus would like... Oh, I do have something... It should be all right.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: With that in mind... Do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do. What is it?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The object I intend to give him is a weapon like the one I carry. A different one from my usual weapon.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'd like to test whether it's still serviceable. I hope you'll help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Just as we rehearsed together last time, I'd like your help practicing again. To you, it will be sparring... But don't worry. Think of it as a little fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sparring with you, Glaucos... That won't be easy.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'll tell you about Daedalus once we're finished.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: While I look for it in the theater's storeroom, please come to the final stage. The storeroom is behind it.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Do you remember the stage overlooking the sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I remember. I'll meet you there.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Thank you. See you shortly.
(Glaucos quickly disappears behind the stage.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something special about that weapon...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's spar with Glaucos first and hear what he has to say.
(As the sparring continues, a satisfied smile spreads across Glaucos's face.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: That should be enough. You can put away your weapon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. I was wondering how long we'd have to keep going.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Here. Take this.
(Glaucos hands %s the weapon he was holding.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I originally made it as a theatrical prop, but it turned out better than expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's quite sharp and sturdy.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Isn't it? I made it after being inspired by something a traveler carried when they visited the island.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When was that?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Before the continent of Freios split apart, so... Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds like an awfully long time ago. Oh, you said you'd tell me after we sparred?

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then let me tell you about my connection with Daedalus...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I was born as a god's incarnation, but after being given life, I gradually learned something. I was an imperfect being, with more things I could not do than things I could.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I tried to do many things to make up for those shortcomings. I believed my experiences would help other living beings.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I wanted many visitors to come and enjoy everything on this island. It didn't always work, but even that wasn't so bad.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I could learn from my mistakes and move forward... That is life. I could accept that, but...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Watching the lives beside me fade was always painful. All I could do was care for them...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I no longer remember how many spirits and animals vanished by my side.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: When Scylla drifted ashore unconscious on Aie Island, I thought she would wake soon. But at some point, she developed a fierce fever and could not awaken.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I wanted to use my long experience to save the dying Scylla, but there was nothing I could do. I had become a living being powerless before death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (To think a god's incarnation regarded life with such feelings...)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Then a pair of brothers found this island, hidden from sight among the vortices of magic.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Talos and Daedalus. They braved those vortices to reach me and seek my advice...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I remember them as people working for coexistence between the Silvaria Kingdom, which sought dominance over the continent, and Creed, the beastfolk's territory...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (According to Medea, the current Talos is Daedalus, who killed his younger brother Talos and took his form... But a kingdom? Was the empire originally a kingdom?)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I don't know why the ancient beastfolk recorded my name and Ocellino's, but the brothers sought answers from me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: They seemed that desperate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ocellino...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Did he not die long ago? Do you know about him as well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... I'll tell you when I have the chance.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Very well. I mistook the brothers for intruders at first, but once I realized they meant no harm, we talked.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: They grieved that, though they followed a god, they could not save their people in that god's name.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: There wasn't much I could offer. I thought stories of the gods might help, so I told them things they did not know about the Twilight era...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: They seemed surprisingly satisfied. Then they made medicine from ingredients they had brought from Knossos to ease Scylla's illness.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Scylla's fever fell, and there was hope she might awaken. Overjoyed, I tried to give the brothers gifts, but Talos, the younger, said it was unnecessary and even refused what his brother wanted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was the weapon you gave me.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Exactly. I don't know why Talos refused... One warm, sunny day, they said I had helped them and left in haste.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I never learned how I had helped... But that was the last I saw of them.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: A few days later, Scylla thankfully awakened. After Hayden explained things, she was able to live with us on the island.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: I'm glad I can finally repay Daedalus for that kindness, but I don't know why he needs this now...

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: The Daedalus you know seems very different from the past... Could you tell me a little about him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you everything I know.
(Glaucos looks shocked after hearing %s's account of Daedalus, now known as Talos.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Give the weapon back to me for a moment. I'll return it shortly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Here...
(Glaucos holds the returned weapon together with the weapon in his other hand. A holy light briefly appears around them, then fades.)

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: Here. Take it. I've infused it with the island's essence so it cannot be used for evil. If he uses it to act against the gods, he will surely regret it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's reassuring.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: ...I'm glad I can help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going. Thank you for your time.

lines.speaker: 글라우코스
lines.text: If you ever need a weapon or something similar, come see me. While sorting through the dusty storeroom, I may find something useful to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Haha... I feel like I'll be visiting often...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall I go back to Talos...? Nothing bad will happen, right?
(Talos seems unresponsive, but his ears are noticeably more alert than usual.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You brought it, as promised. Hand it over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After all the trouble I took, that's what you say... You're not even hiding it now.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hiding what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daedalus.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What about him? He's already gone. Oh, this is better than I expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glaucos said he was glad to finally repay that old kindness.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Fine. That incarnation... No, even when we first met, he was just an old man who'd lived a long time.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hehe. No wonder Daedalus coveted it. That incarnation said it was nothing, but the truth is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Want to hear more? You think that comes free?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does the conversation always turn this way?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You learned more about a popular fellow like me through all this. Don't get upset over nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what if I do get more upset?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Right this instant, I could take a village of the Silvaria Empire and... Ow, that stings!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Make a village sting? Oh! Lepton!
(The Elec Lepton has appeared unnoticed and is rubbing its whole body against Talos.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Aaagh! Get it off me!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if I don't want to?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I said get it off!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Try saying 'Please get it off.'

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Aaagh, get it off! Get it off me!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lepton, can you put a little more feeling into that rubbing?
(At %s's words, the Lepton's expression turns into an exclamation mark. Sensing disaster, Talos bows his head.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Get it off!! I'll tell you one thing you want to know!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good, Talos. Lepton, you heard him? Back off for now. Next time he threatens people, hide here and give him a sting, all right?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What a vicious spirit I've run into. Well, it can't be helped. It's useful to Knossos, so I'll let it slide this once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Still talking big, I see.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A sharp tongue keeps you alive. Ugh...
(The Lepton flies up in front of Talos's face and begins circling.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: All right, all right. Calm down. I'll at least keep quiet in front of the Lepton. Now I'll give you something. A hint. Just a hint.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A hint?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Remember the voice of Orca's subordinate, still making a racket in Ell Anor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... That voice...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Orca promised him he would return someday. But he never came back. Just like the ancient god who fled.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: See you later, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, what do you mean...?
(As soon as he finishes, Talos climbs a tree and bounds away. You try to follow, but cannot hope to catch someone who knows Knossos so thoroughly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Orca's subordinate...? I can't remember his name... I should look into it. But what about him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I'd better head back for now. Talos doesn't seem likely to say anything more.
(As the adventurer makes the way back to the Ell Anor Mountain Path, Talos slowly descends from the tree where he had vanished.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I dangled the bait, just as you threatened me to do. So don't come bothering me again, you 'witches.'
